description: This file defines an internal interface IRemoteGrainDirectory within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. It specifies methods for managing grain activations in a distributed system, including registration, lookup, and partition acceptance functionalities.

classes.name: IRemoteGrainDirectory
classes.description: An internal interface for managing grain directory operations such as registration, lookup, and split partition acceptance in a distributed Orleans system.

methods.name: RegisterMany
methods.description: Registers multiple grain addresses remotely, typically during handoff.

methods.name: LookUpMany
methods.description: Retrieves updated information for a list of grains, used to refresh directory caches.

methods.name: AcceptSplitPartition
methods.description: Accepts and registers activations resulting from a split partition.
